ety.text: Derived from Proto-New Indo-Aryan *धक्क-धक्क- (dhakka-dhakka-, “flaring”), a reduplication of *धक्क- (dhakka-), a variant of *धग्ग (dhagga, “throbbing, glittering”). Compare attested Prakrit धगधगइ (dhagadhagaï, “to flare”), धग्गीकय (dhaggīkaya, “blazing”). The -ग्- (-g-) variant the ancestor of Hindi धगधगाना (dhagadhgānā).
